description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 25.04.2016 to 01.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and charges should be calculated based on currency exchange rates. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
